authority: Canonical language-independent projection procedure. JavaScript, Python or another implementation must realize these steps; implementation code does not define their meaning.
purpose: Derive per-index agent-facing projection data from current procedure content while defining shared content once.

representation.ref: Named runtime value or prior result; never executable source code
representation.field: Object field lookup; missing fields fail unless explicitly optional
representation.operations: OP.01 opcodes name registered operations. action binds the opcode to the fixed algorithm described here. No implicit semantic inference.

inputs.procedure: Current complete canonical procedure JSON object
inputs.supplied_inputs_by_index: Optional externally supplied substantive inputs keyed by index

outputs.shared_semantic_criteria: Current criterion definitions referenced by shared criteria IDs
outputs.definitions: Distinct index-specific projection bodies, once each
outputs.index_projections: Ordered index identity, projection key and supplied substantive inputs when present

invariants: Read current procedure values at invocation time; do not save an index-position pointer table.
Preserve procedure wording and JSON values without paraphrase.
Preserve input index order and identities; no fixed number of indices.
Do not infer or choose a framing operator, abstraction mode or substantive input.
This procedure neither renders UI nor advances state.
Reject missing references, cycles, conflicting inheritance, duplicate identities and missing criteria; do not emit a partial successful result.

literal: supplied_inputs_by_index is an object when supplied

steps.reason: Establish actual sources and reject malformed input before deriving any instructions.
Obtain shared obligations from their current definition rather than repeating or rewriting them.
Maintain one lookup for distinct content while preserving separately ordered index occurrences.

stop.literal: after every supplied index contract; no invented or fixed index count

steps.reason: Each occurrence is projected from its actual current contract; repeated content reuses a definition.

cardinality.literal: exactly one definition per requested ID

steps.reason: Array position must not determine which criterion a reference means.
Return concrete projection data for a renderer, without claiming that UI rendering or task execution occurred.

predicate.literal: source must be a non-null non-array object

steps.reason: Only objects can supply contract fields.

absent.literal: Return a deep copy of source

steps.reason: Unreferenced definitions are already concrete; referenced definitions need explicit resolution.

literal: Traverse own fields only; missing target fails
Reject a pointer already in reference_chain

steps.reason: Resolve against the current document and prevent stale targets or recursive loops.

reference_chain.literal: prior chain plus the current definition_ref value

steps.reason: Follow the full inheritance chain; one level of lookup would omit obligations.

right.literal: deep copy of source excluding definition_ref

steps.reason: Compose inherited and local fields without permitting silent overrides.

algorithm: Start with a deep copy of left.
For each own field in right: if absent in left, copy its complete value.
If both values are objects, recursively apply MERGE_EXACT.
Treat arrays and scalar values atomically. Existing atomic values must be equal; otherwise fail with the conflicting field.
Reject unsafe prototype-related field names; do not mutate either input.
MERGE_EXACT.reason: Inheritance is composition of compatible obligations, not permission to replace them.

algorithm: For every resolved contract field absent from common, retain the complete field.
For object fields present in both, recurse and retain only nonempty differences.
For atomic fields present in both, require structural equality; omit equal fields and fail on disagreement.
Remove contract_id and index from the resulting reusable content body; retain those identities on the index occurrence.
SUBTRACT_COMMON.reason: Shared obligations are defined once; index identity must not prevent reuse of otherwise identical content.

steps.reason: Read the current effective semantic contract, including inherited fields.

literal: index is a nonnegative safe integer
index and contract_id have not occurred previously

steps.reason: Preserve unambiguous index occurrences even when their content is shared.
Isolate only the work that differs from shared obligations.

equality.literal: Structural JSON equality: object key order ignored; array order and scalar types preserved

steps.reason: Repeated framing roles reuse content; changed work receives its own derived projection.

if_false.literal: Allocate projection_(distinct-definition-count + 1), save unique_content once, and retain the content-to-key association

steps.reason: Keys are derived at invocation time rather than fixed to old procedure positions.

literal: supplied_inputs only when externally present for that index
Append occurrence in current input order
Preserve supplied values without inventing defaults

steps.reason: Bind unique work and external substantive inputs to this occurrence without copying shared definitions.

required_information: missing reference, conflicting field or invalid identity
failure_contract.partial_output: Do not return partial data as a complete projection.

environment_boundary.scope: Pure procedure over supplied in-memory values; independent of storage, transport, hosting service, user interface and delivery destination.
environment_boundary.caller_responsibility: A separately configured adapter obtains inputs and receives results. This procedure does not choose, describe or access those locations.
environment_boundary.input_rule: Inputs are values passed to this procedure; names and references identify logical data, not physical sources.
environment_boundary.output_rule: Return result values to the caller. EMIT means returning/serializing a value; it does not mean writing a file, posting a comment or sending a message.
environment_boundary.references: RFC 6901 references resolve within the supplied procedure object only, without external retrieval.
environment_boundary.configuration: Concrete input/output bindings and adapter implementations belong in a separate configuration document.
